$comment: Performance budgets from docs/implementation-plan.md section 8. Times in milliseconds unless named otherwise. 'baseline' entries are measurements, filled in from M1 by the perf-check skill.

machines.minimum: 2020+ laptop, Intel Iris Xe or Radeon 680M class iGPU, 4-core/8-thread CPU, 8 GB shared memory
machines.recommended: 6-core desktop CPU (2020+), mid-range dedicated GPU, 16 GB

m1_2026_11_01.$comment: M1 exit baseline: BattleTickBench (10,000 units on m1-flat, M1 systems: empty steps plus PlaceholderWanderSystem), BenchmarkDotNet short job, Release, .NET 10. Measured on a development desktop (AMD Ryzen 9 5900X, 12 cores), not the floor laptop: re-measure there before M2.

m2_2026_11_02.$comment: M2 baseline (SimVersion 4): godsim run in Release on .NET 10, plus BenchmarkDotNet short jobs for the navigation pieces. Dev desktop, not the floor laptop. m2-bridge is the exit scenario (10,000 attackers crowding one 20 m bridge), the densest case so far.
